name: founder-skill
description: The Founder skill pack for Claude, plus the Day Trader pack

plugins.name: founder-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills that test a business before you launch it: a board, a competitor scout, a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents, pricing, the offer, a CFO, marketing, brand, operations, a launch plan and the business plan. Plus eleven Day Trader skills: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and a Pelosi tracker.
